description: The networks Gloam runs on, mainnets first, with each vault (pool) address, the private swap routers (Robinhood Chain and Tempo mainnet), the assets you can deposit (on mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0 and OUSD on Tempo; USDG, GLOAM, PONS, CASHCAT, ETH, AI and ORBIO on Robinhood Chain; USDC, EURC, USDT and ETH on Base; USDC, USDT, USDG, PYUSD, EURC and ETH on Ethereum; USDC on Elysium, with HYPE and KNTQ once their queued deposit limits land; USDT, USDC (18 decimals each), BNB and BDX on BNB Chain; on testnet: OUSD and PathUSD on Tempo, USDG and ETH on Robinhood Chain, and more on Base Sepolia and Ethereum Sepolia), explorers, RPCs and the testnet faucets. With no network given, also Gloam on Solana (Helius Privacy Rings: in the app, the SDK and the local MCP server), listed apart.

network.description: Gloam network: "robinhood-mainnet" (Robinhood Chain mainnet: USDG, GLOAM, PONS, CASHCAT, ETH, AI and ORBIO), "base-mainnet" (Base mainnet: USDC, EURC, USDT, ETH), "bnb-mainnet" (BNB Chain mainnet: USDT and USDC with 18 decimals, BNB, and BDX capped at 100,000 per deposit; gas in BNB), "tempo-mainnet" (Tempo mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0, OUSD), "ethereum-mainnet" (Ethereum mainnet: USDC, USDT, USDG, PYUSD, EURC, ETH), "elysium-mainnet" (Elysium mainnet: USDC, then HYPE and KNTQ once their queued deposit limits land; gas in HYPE), or a testnet: "tempo" (Tempo Moderato), "robinhood" (Robinhood Chain testnet), "base" (Base Sepolia) or "ethereum" (Ethereum Sepolia). Leave out for every network.
